subject: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ally Nguyen <ally@moduhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split

Hi Ally —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our chat with Will, ModuHealth is ready to move to an annual committed private offer but asked for two practical concessions to smooth procurement and onboarding: (1) frontloading a portion of the committed capacity in Q1 to cover an expected pilot surge, and (2) annualizing the invoice but splitting it into two tranches for AP timing.

Attached is a PO draft and a proposed invoice schedule. High-level proposal: 12‑month term starting 2028-01-01, committed token capacity 600M/year, with 30% of the annual commitment (equivalent to 180M tokens) made available immediately at activation (frontload). Billing: 60% invoice on activation, 40% invoice at the 6‑month mark. We can also do a 3-tranche split if AP needs more granularity (50/30/20) — see the CSV.

Can you confirm whether AP will accept the 60/40 split and whether ModuHealth can sign via DocuSign? If yes, I’ll loop in our Legal (Kimberly) and Finance (Ben) to finalize the private offer paperwork and route the AWS Private Offer.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm billing split and PO number (Ally/AP)
- Redwood: generate private offer URL and send DocuSign (Marissa/Ben)
- Legal review limited to the acceptance window (Kimberly)
- Onboarding check-in: Jordan to schedule an ops kickoff after acceptance

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-1284

Attachments: ModuHealth_PO_Draft.pdf (PO draft), Invoice_Schedule_Q4-2027.csv (proposed tranches)

From: Ally Nguyen <ally@moduhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Will Torres <will@moduhealth.com>, accounts-payable@moduhealth.com
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear proposal. We like the approach; the pilot surge requirement means the frontload makes sense. A couple of notes from AP/finance:
- AP prefers two invoices if they are large enough; 60/40 should be OK but we need the activation invoice to show the full PO number and be payable within 30 days.
- For internal forecasting, can you change the effective term to 2028-01-01 through 2028-12-31 and include a per-month usage cap for the frontloaded tranche so we can show runway?
- Also need the AWS Private Offer URL and the redlined PO in PDF for our procurement team.

Will copies to AP (accounts-payable@moduhealth.com) — they’ll confirm payment terms and PO requirements. If AP signs off, we can route the PO and sign via DocuSign.

—Ally
Director of Procurement, ModuHealth
ally@moduhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Ally Nguyen <ally@moduhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Oct 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split

Thanks Marissa / Ally —

Ben from Finance here. Quick confirmations and asks from our side:
1) 60/40 split is workable. We need the PO to include ModuHealth's tax ID and billing address; AP typically requires net‑30 on the activation invoice.
2) For accounting treatment, we will record the full committed revenue on acceptance and then recognize per ASC guidance over the 12 months; frontloaded capacity doesn't change recognition, but AP wants the allocation spelled out in the invoice (we can add an invoice line for the "frontloaded allocation" to make it explicit).
3) Send the final PO PDF so we can attach to the AWS Private Offer and trigger bill-of-sale metadata.

I’ll queue up the DocuSign envelope and will need the PO number and the exact invoice schedule before I finalize. Tagging Kimberly for legal quick review on any non-standard acceptance language.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Ally Nguyen <ally@moduhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Oct 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split

Thanks — I reviewed the attached PO draft. A couple of legal flags (minor):
- We should avoid language that implies unlimited carryover of frontloaded tokens; recommend a clause: "Frontloaded allocation valid for first 90 days of the term; unused frontloaded tokens will be available for use through month three and then revert to the committed pool without refund."
- Confirm that PII/data residency obligations remain per the base Private Offer (we should mirror existing SOC2/contractual references).
- If AP requests additional indemnity or audit clauses, flag those for an exec approval route.

If Ally confirms the PO number and tax/billing details, I can commit to a 24‑hour review turnaround and then Ben can finalize the DocuSign envelope.

Kimberly Park
Lead Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Ally Nguyen <ally@moduhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@moduhealth.com, Will Torres <will.torres@moduhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 10:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ModuHealth renewal: frontloaded capacity + annualized invoice split

Hi all —

AP confirmed: 60/40 split acceptable. PO number will be MH-2028-1107 and we will provide tax ID and billing address in a follow-up. We also accept the "frontloaded allocation" language proposed by Kimberly with the 90-day window.

Action items from ModuHealth side:
- AP to send final PO PDF to marissa@redwood.com (cc accounts-payable)
- Will to coordinate signatory for DocuSign once envelope is ready

Please send the AWS Private Offer link and DocuSign route when ready.

Thanks,
Ally

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Jordan — please schedule the onboarding kickoff for the week of 2028-01-02 and prepare a list of required onboarding artifacts (API keys, VPC connection checklist, SOC2 evidence). Ben — please finalize the activation invoice lines to reflect the frontloaded allocation as discussed (we need final invoice PDF before e-signature). Kimberly — if you can do the 24-hour review after the final PO PDF lands, we should be ready to close.

Thanks everyone — excited to get ModuHealth onboarded.

Best,
Marissa
